name: @ragenai/guardrails
description: Guardrail contracts and the pure rule resolver — shared by apps/web, apps/api and apps/admin so the runtime and the authoring surface cannot disagree about what a rule is
//exports: Two entry points, because one of them must be reachable from a browser. The root barrel re-exports the ReDoS probe, which imports `node:worker_threads` at module scope — Turbopack cannot externalise that for a client chunk, so a `'use client'` component importing the barrel builds fine and then blanks the page on hydration with `Cannot find module 'node:worker_threads'`. `./contracts` is the vocabulary alone: no imports at all, which is what makes it safe to say so here.
